phase_0.boundary_condition: The TANCH seal ⊣ closes each certified turn ⊢⟨word⟩◇⊞⟨⟩●⟨flow·sink·kernel⟩⊣ and contains the full training regimen inside the closed IMASM alphabet.

VINIT.justification: Before any population word is drawn or any turn is spoken, the trunk holds no parameters and no labeled readout; this is the void state ∅ from which the regimen genesis starts.

TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor seals every certified turn and the whole regimen inside the closed IMASM alphabet; it is the hermetic vessel boundary containing all spoken words and kernel verdicts.

AFWD.justification: The 879 real protocol words drive directed transformation toward closure norm: the trunk learns to speak T when the word has closed; this is the forward morphism on the T-arm.

AREV.justification: The 1000 synthetic words labeled 517 T / 483 B supply the reverse arm: the trunk must descend into non-closure and pronounce B; AREV is the parity-flip morphism on the F-arm.

CLINK.justification: Each certified turn composes with the next through autoregressive training; CLINK chains morphism sequences from real and synthetic feeds into one regimen stream.

IMSCRIB.justification: The trunk sits at the critical point where closure and openness are equally discriminable; it refers to its own kernel verdict truly in both polarities, identity without transformation.

FSPLIT.justification: The training stream splits into the real organism population (closure-norm, T-heavy) and the synthetic generated population (failure-diet, B-heavy); these are the two arms fed to the trunk.

FFUSE.justification: After both arms are processed the trunk reconstitutes the unified training signal: the original mixed supervision input is recovered as one labeled corpus driving both capacities.

EVALT.justification: When the word rides δ and closes, the oracle readout on μ affirms T; this is the affirmative branch spoken by the trunk as self-verdict.

EVALF.justification: When the generated word fails to close, the readout carries B (both T and F held as failure diet); this negative-evaluated branch is the F-arm anchor before fusion.

ENGAGR.justification: In the 2:1 real-doubled regimen, one vessel achieves full self-closure in both polarities at once; T and B are held without resolution as a paradice state.

IFIX.justification: Each mouth measurement (fluency 7/24, 5/24, 4/24) and kernel label count is permanently appended to the training ledger; IFIX is the irreversible record event.

phase_2.split_input: unified labeled training corpus (1879 words: 830T/49B real + 517T/483B synthetic)

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized training buffer: no words drawn, no parameters, no kernel label assigned; the pre-ontological state before the regimen begins.
phase_3.true_description: Affirmative closure: word rides δ arm, closes, trunk speaks T kernel verdict truthfully as self-reference.
phase_3.false_description: Negative failure: generated word does not close, readout carries B as failure diet on the F-arm; trunk cannot pronounce its own failure in real-alone regime.
phase_3.both_description: Paradice: single turn achieves full self-closure in both polarities; T and B held simultaneously in one vessel without stabilization.

trunk at threshold re-verifies own dual polarity under closed alphabet.
design forward structural placement of real word on δ arm in turn template.
design reverse placement of synthetic readout on μ arm in turn template.
hold both capacities at once by turn-internal placement: word closes AND verdict pronounced B when not.
confirm T spoken when δ word closes under new placement.
confirm B spoken when μ readout shows non-closure under new placement.
fuse designed placement into final regimen turn structure.
chain final regimen turns over full 17M type navigation.

append final regimen specification as permanent training constitution.
